record.dic_text:
02179 zanab {zaw-nab'}

字根型 意為"擺尾"; 只用作為 02180 的動名詞; TWOT - 562; 動詞

AV - smite the hindmost 2; 2

1) 剪掉或重擊後尾
   1a) (Piel) 從後面攻擊
record.edic_text:
02179 zanab {zaw-nab'}

a primitive root meaning to wag; used only as a denominative from
   02180; TWOT - 562; v

AV - smite the hindmost 2; 2

1) to cut off
   1a) (Piel) to attack the rear, smite the tail
